$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for SUM-CHAT@v1 on spaarkedev1. Normalized from the legacy {"args":[...]} format by the G-P3 UAT round-1 fix wave (H2, 2026-07-07) — the legacy format projected an effectively-empty permissive schema to the LLM (every member an unknown keyword). CI-validated against the OpenAI function-parameters subset by CatalogInputSchemaContractTests (H4). Custom keywords elicitation_prompt / ledger_resolution are maker metadata (unknown keywords, OpenAI-tolerated). Property-level "required": true is FORBIDDEN (invalid JSON Schema — 400-fails the whole request); use the object-level required array.

fileIds.description: Optional subset of session file ids to summarize. Omit to use ALL files in the chat-session manifest (FR-08); hard cap 20 per NFR-02.
fileIds.elicitation_prompt: Which uploaded file(s) should I summarize?
fileIds.ledger_resolution: session.uploadedFiles — omitted fileIds default to ALL files in the chat-session manifest (FR-08); hard cap 20 per NFR-02

styleHint.description: Optional free-form style token from the user's utterance (e.g. executive, detailed, bullet-points).
styleHint.ledger_resolution: none — free-form style token from the user's utterance
